bullets.content: [general] Pick a submission by estimated score, not by the lowest error or highest energy alone. Compute each candidate's score from the task's own formula and its DOFs. Here that is 345/(e*DOFs) with e from nonlinear_check.

[general] Change exactly ONE factor per solve vs a measured base (two changes gave unattributable results). If two look promising, solve each alone against the same base. Use the whole solve budget; view(kind=error) after each.

[general] Read mesh()'s 'element size near each group' BEFORE every solve. If a targeted group's h is within 10% of global h (not >=1.3x below), the refinement failed: fix with free mesh() calls, never a solve. After EVERY solve view(kind=error) and check hotspot local h <= requested x1.1.

[general] Before any nonlinear_check: mesh base, linear-solve with statement setup, view(kind=error) in iso and z (REPEATED twice), list top-5 hotspots with local h vs box size; place boxes where local h >1.3x request. compare(previous, current).

[general] Don't re-run identical meshes as noise controls (deterministic). Never check meshes whose node counts differ <1% (5777 vs 5784 gave 2.49/2.48%, a tie). After one tie in a plateau, move remaining checks to untried regions; make bold changes for diversity.

[general] Submit by product e x nodes, never worse than your own best unless the mesh carries a new target that can earn diversity. Only meshes below best product (12.93k) by >3% justify submission; branch noise is ±0.1-0.15 pt, so a <0.1 pt gain is a tie.
[general] Don't let your own 'avoid' notes stop free mesh() scans: a scan costs no budget. A skip-0.004-box note cost the winning 5474-node branch that a2 found in 7 free calls.

[general] Obey your own node/quality gate. You set nodes<=6000 then submitted 6017 for a 0.06 pt noise gain over 5977. A gate-breaking candidate must beat the in-gate one by >0.1 pt. Write the gate, compare in one line, then check.

[general] One factor per check: list differences from the last checked mesh, split if more than one. Removing arms AND adding a slab was unattributable; h and box changed together gave 3.08-3.09%. Hold h fixed while scanning box size.
[general] Prefer mesh branches with quality.min well above the gate: 0.1103 meshes were 0.0103 from invalid; a2's cheap branch had 0.26. With similar nodes, take higher quality.

[general] On a physical-test task the yardstick is the measured curve, not energy. Training-task break-evens (SE per DOF, eta x1.22, compare-diff calibration) do not transfer. Re-derive break-even from that task's score formula before each accept.

[general] A score formula with a branch (quadratic below g=2, linear above) needs the branch checked per candidate. Mixing branches makes a worse mesh look better. Write formula and branch next to every logged result.
[general] Point refinements are nearly inert: 0.0026->0.0022 changed nodes 5711->5714. Use {box}, {group} or {edge}. Confirm the size near target groups is <=0.8x h before solving.

[general] Delivered box h is ~1.2-1.3x the request when box is <1.4x finer than h or radius <=0.003. Never check a nested box <1.4x finer than surroundings (slab 0.007 in h 0.008 was noise). Free-mesh: <1% node change means inert.

[general] A nested face-group refinement must be >=1.6x finer than its surrounding box after ~1.3x delivery lag. f37 at 0.0027 in a 0.004 box (1.48x) was swallowed. Request <=0.0025 inside 0.004, or use a corner box.
[general] Box radius is inert for node count (h 0.007 lean recipe: 6164 nodes at r0.003 and r0.0015). Don't spend solves on box radius; change size or extent.

[general] Node count is non-monotone and branchy in h and box sizes. Free-mesh several candidates first and solve the cheapest valid one. If quality is near the limit, shift a box edge by 0.0002 or h by 0.0005.

[general] Boxes reaching outer x faces (|x|=0.031) below y -0.02 flip gmsh to an expensive branch: 6707-7630 nodes vs 5511. Confine new boxes there to |x|<=0.019 (5821 nodes); stop scanning after 2 branch jumps.
[general] Never spend a solve on uniform h coarsening of a recipe whose local refinements were inert: h 0.0063 (14.2k, ~23%) told nothing new; uniform h is break-even.
[general] When two solves tie on the accuracy measure (bc0: 0.008% energy apart with 6% fewer DOFs), DOFs decide: submit the cheaper.

[general] A wide box over all load-carrying parts at ~half the outer h, with coarse outer h where plastic strain is ~0, beat targeted groups under fine global h on e x nodes (16.1k vs 16.8-17.2k). Trim box edges one at a time.

[general] Diversity needs structural difference (other order, h off >1.5x, or mostly different targets) AND base >=90% of best. Targets in the shared playbook get copied (a2 duplicated the slab mesh, both lost bonus). Use a target in no playbook note.
[general] Before betting on diversity, compute 0.9x best plausible peer base (last gen 0.892 -> 0.803; yours 0.811 passed by 0.008). Submit a worse-product unique mesh only if e x nodes <= ~14.3k.

[general] For diversity drop peers' inert parts (arm boxes) and add a target nobody uses (base junction slab). Shared carrier+pockets plus unique slab, no arm boxes, is closest to 'mostly different targets' while keeping base >=90% of best.

[general] REPEATED: unused nonlinear_checks (left 2 unused). Plan all 6: 2 on assigned factor, 1 cheapest twin, 1 diagnostic, 1 spare, 1 best untested idea. Write break-even e<12930/nodes before each.

[general] Gates are binding. Before each nonlinear_check restate nodes and q next to the gate; if it fails, skip or write one line why relaxed. Last run all 4 checks failed gates, 3 were predictably worse (q~0.14).

[general] Before submit, view(error, z) and list each hotspot's local h vs requested box size. A hotspot in the 0.004 carrier (e.g. f6 arm waist, x ±27.5, y 3.65 mm) is the next target. Promised and skipped before.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Score ~345/(e%*DOFs/1000) for e<3.92%, times diversity bonus. 2.44% at 17.46k DOFs gave base 0.811. Log e, nodes, score per check; submit the max.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Truth is nonlinear_check's e (max 6, minutes each); the linear solve (max 12) is only a proxy. nonlinear_check the exact mesh you will submit. Submit the solve with the best 345/(e*DOFs) from nonlinear_check, never a linear-only candidate or remembered value.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Schedule all 6 nonlinear checks before meshing, on structurally different or one-factor candidates (4 h candidates, 1 spare with pocket-box edge shifted 0.0002 if q<0.2, 1 confirm/untried idea). Stopping at 2 of 6 repeated; unused checks are wasted.
[general] Free-mesh candidates first; spend nonlinear_checks only on cheapest valid ones (reject over 6000 nodes by free count). Prefer quality.min >=0.15; if <0.105 shift a box edge by 0.0002.
[general] Proxy reactions f17/f34 (-4412/-4444 N at 5486 nodes) balance but rank meshes weakly; judge by nonlinear_check only.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Before each nonlinear_check search notes for that node count/recipe: box 0.0038 at h 0.008 (6129 nodes, 2.94%) was re-checked wastefully. Identical recipe = skip.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] REPEATED: after the first linear solve call view(kind=error, iso) immediately (skipped g7, g8). Write top hotspot local h vs box size before any nonlinear_check. Check pocket corners (x ±22.6, y 25.7 mm) vs 0.0025; >0.0033 means swallowed.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Base slab is dead: 0.005 2.38% (+253 nodes), 0.006 2.34%, 0.007 inert 2.44%, full-width 0.0055 2.21% at 5981 nodes; none beat 12.93k. Base block PEEQ ~0. Drop slab from all recipes.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] The 1.0 mm excess sits inside the carrier, not the base: carrier 0.0048 raised it to +6.6% (3.37%), carrier-free h 0.005 gave 3.22%, base slabs moved it <=0.1 pt. Target y -20..32 mm.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] 1.0 mm checkpoint stays +5.66-5.8% in all variants (47% of mean); gains come at 1.5-2.5 mm. Pocket size is the live lever: 0.0025 gave 2.30% (peak PEEQ x 21.7) vs 0.0028 at 2.44-2.52%.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Slab: 2.44% at 5821 vs control ~2.52% at 5511 (-0.08 pt for +5.6% nodes); loses base score, value is diversity only. Bore bottom is dark in PEEQ; plastic bands are mid-height bore flanks and neck fillets.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Best recipe a3 g8: h 0.008, carrier 0.004, pockets 0.0025, arms 0.0034, plus left-pocket box 0.0023 r0.003 (+38 nodes): 5650 nodes, q 0.221, 2.29%, 12.93k. Assigned h variant: free-mesh h 0.0077, 0.0078, 0.00785, 0.0079, 0.00795, 0.0082; h 0.0079 w/o box gave 5581, q 0.244. Check cheapest q>=0.2 at <=5620 nodes.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Cheap asymmetric touch-ups inside an existing box are the right scale on this plateau: left-pocket 0.0023 r0.003 box (f15/f37 PEEQ hotspot, x≈-21.6 mm) gave 2.29% vs 2.35% for +38 nodes. Test pocket 0.0022 as one factor.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Fallback probe: in a1's recipe pocket boxes 0.0028->0.0025 (arm 0.0034). a3's 0.0025 gave 2.45% vs 2.49%, +59 nodes. Expect ~2.38-2.42% at ~5800; check only if q>=0.1, nodes<=5850.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Arm-waist boxes at 0.003-0.0034 are swallowed (f6 stays ~4.1 mm): 2.48/2.49/2.60% at 5777-5803 nodes vs 2.46% without at 5746; ~0.05 pt for +42 nodes. Skip arm boxes.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Coarse global h is an expensive branch: h 0.009-0.03 gave 6625-9902 nodes, all above 5650. Don't scan h>0.0082; the >1.5x h diversity route is closed.
